reference.formulation: Q8 serendipity plane stress, 3x3 Gauss, consistent quadratic edge traction

recovery_cross_check.meaning: audit recovery disagrees with the stored stress field; pointwise stress comparison is not certifiable

scope: Pointwise interior stress components and von Mises at five fixed material points, against an independently coded Q8 plane-stress solution with Richardson extrapolation. Element-centre/nodal peak values on the loaded-edge traction discontinuity and at the clamped corner are excluded: those are singular and do not converge pointwise.
